title: 8 nabbed, P293,000 'shabu' seized in Caraga drug busts

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Eight drug suspects were arrested and 43.21 grams of suspected “shabu” (crystal meth) valued at P293,828 were seized in a series of anti-drug operations across the Caraga region on Nov. 20 and 21, the Police Regional Office 13 (PRO-13) reported. In a statement, PRO-13 director Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon said the two-day haul came from eight separate buy-bust operations conducted in coordination with the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA). The biggest single haul was recorded in Trento, Agusan del Sur, where joint operatives from the Provincial Intelligence Unit, Trento Municipal Police Station, and PDEA-13 arrested […]...
